purpose: Test whether a full-body intermediate can preserve a coherent leftward turn before face-detail refinement.
finding: Human review accepts that the final candidate is rotated toward image-left. This pass validates the pose-direction objective only. Face shape, eye/iris appearance, and detailed identity continuity remain separate gates and are not approved by the rotation decision.
next_gate: Use the passed full-body rotation as a pose reference for a later face-identity refinement experiment; do not treat it as an approved character-pack asset until identity review passes.
